learning_outcomes.text: Understands basic notions regarding the rules and techniques of sports games and gymnastics exercises.
Knows the structure and main purpose of the physical exercises and sports practiced within physical education disciplines.
Understands the role of physical activity in the physical and mental balance necessary for a demanding engineering career.
Is capable of correctly applying technical and tactical elements from athletics, gymnastics, sports games, or fitness.
Participates actively in exercises and applied games for the development of basic motor skills.
Demonstrates physical skills and coordination in the execution of individual or group exercises.
Adapts physical effort to personal capabilities and contributes to team sports activities.
Manifests responsibility in respecting regulations, safety norms, and instructors' indications.
Demonstrates autonomy in practicing physical exercise outside of class hours.
Assumes correct and collaborative behavior in collective sports activities.
Becomes aware of the importance of physical education in long-term personal and professional development.

syllabus_topics: Athletics: elements of running
Technique of launched step and standing start
Middle-distance running step
Varied terrain running (jogging)
Basic, aerobic and artistic gymnastics: front and formation exercises, walking and running variations, simple floor exercises
Game-like exercises and simple dynamic elements from acrobatic gymnastics (rolls, inversions, etc.)
Applied circuits combined with balance, climbing, transport elements
Classical, modern and popular dance steps to appropriate music
Sports games: basketball, handball, football, volleyball, badminton
Fundamental positions, placement and movement on the field
Simple kicks, serves, exercises for receiving, catching, and passing the ball from a standstill and while running
Exercises for finalizing technical and elementary technical-tactical actions, marking and unmarked exercises
Global participation in games on reduced and normal fields with different teams
Improvement of basic and specific motor qualities for certain sports branches, using means of bodybuilding, athletics, fitness
Increase of strength and muscle mass through appropriate and individualized use of weights, dumbbells and barbells
Exercises for adjusting forms and transforming fats into active mass
Improvement of speed manifestation forms (reaction, repetition, displacement, execution through specific exercises)
Amelioration of general coordination indices and specific dexterity for different specific branches
Increase of mobility and flexibility at the level of different segments
Increase of running resistance

assessment_methods.method: Laboratory activity (including lab sheets and colloquium)

assessment_rules: Student promotes the discipline if demonstrating fundamental practical skills in athletics, gymnastics, sports games, and bodybuilding/fitness. This includes executing specific techniques correctly and efficiently, actively participating in sports activities, and improving basic and specific motor skills through individualized training. The final evaluation combines scores and weights from each activity. Integer grades from 1 to 10 are awarded, with a minimum grade of 5 required to certify acquisition of minimal learning outcomes and earn credits.
